versions.changelog: Reworked commuter-to-workplace matching to reproduce census commute totals exactly; recomputed map geometry in the map's local projection for accurate shapes and a lighter download.
Restored dropped coastal and island neighborhoods, thinned over-drawn building foundations, and back-filled sparse building footprints.
Initial release of the Keihanshin map built with the full modeling pipeline — per-building foundations, 3D building heights, fuller land use, and a full range of demand points.
